tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background and the default video ground. The darkest/lightest surface in each theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, sidebars, code blocks and the 'paper' behind the logo. Sits on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers and the player bar. On surface, separate it with `line`, not a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-ground
tokens.usage: Ground beneath navigation rails and headers, with panels floating above. Surface in light, canvas in dark.

tokens.name: surface-float
tokens.usage: Layer 3 of the web app: menus, popovers, the question the agent waits on, the home composer; always with a shadow. Raised in light, surface in dark.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted blocks: the app-icon tile, a dark hero band on a light page, tooltips. Not a button fill; buttons use action.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the outlines of cards, inputs and secondary buttons. Deliberately weak: a control is found by its label and fill, not by this line.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger dividers and the hover border of secondary buttons; holds 3:1 against surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the logo's play glyph and "Talk", on canvas, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timecodes at rest; on canvas, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: the main non-playback action of a view (Export, Save, Create). Calm neutral so cue stays rare.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action fill.

tokens.name: cue
tokens.usage: The signal of playback: the play glyph in controls (never the logo's), the playhead, the active word, and the play/render button only. A fill, never body text; label it with on-cue.

tokens.name: on-cue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cue fill (the play button label, ticks on the played track). Always ink, never white: white on cue is 3.4:1.

tokens.name: cue-text
tokens.usage: Cue as text or a 1.5px icon ('Now playing', the active timecode), on canvas, surface, surface-raised and cue-soft. Not for links.

tokens.name: cue-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind cue-text: the active scene card, the cue tag.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The logo's frame and the "Viso" of the wordmark: a deeper blue than `cue`, so the brand reads before the signal does. Artwork only; no UI element takes it.

tokens.name: guide
tokens.usage: The editing layer: selection outlines, layout guides, keyframe overrides, the focus ring. Never a brand accent; never in exported video.

tokens.name: guide-text
tokens.usage: Guide as text (editor labels, override markers) on canvas, surface, surface-raised and guide-soft.

tokens.name: guide-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind guide-text and selected rows.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px canvas gap, then a solid 2px ring. 3:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Render passed, QA clean. As text or icon on canvas, surface, surface-raised and success-soft; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs review (manual overrides that may not survive a re-layout, a missing licence). Text or icon, with a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: voice-female
tokens.usage: Muted rose ground behind a female voice's editorial portrait. Decorative only; the voice's name is always adjacent.

tokens.name: voice-male
tokens.usage: Muted blue ground behind a male voice's editorial portrait. Decorative only; the voice's name is always adjacent.

tokens.name: agent-soft
tokens.usage: Warm ground for an assistant's messages, distinct from the person's messages on surface. ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed render, broken frame, destructive action. Magenta-red so it never reads as cue. Text or icon, with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: caption-plate
tokens.usage: Subtitle and lower-third plate inside video frames, in both themes (video is not themed).

tokens.name: caption-ink
tokens.usage: Subtitle text on caption-plate.

tokens.name: caption-active
tokens.usage: The word being spoken, inside a subtitle on caption-plate (lighter than cue to hold 4.5:1 on the plate).

families.sans: "Schibsted Grotesk", "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero only, one per page.

styles.name: display

styles.usage: Section heroes, the cover name.

styles.name: h1

styles.name: h2

styles.name: h3

styles.name: title

styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, marketing body.

styles.usage: Default body copy.

styles.usage: Dense UI, table cells, help text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, form labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: IR, JSON, CLI. Ligatures off (font-variant-ligatures: none).

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Inline code in dense UI, line numbers.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Scene numbers and times. Tabular figures.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels, panel captions. Set the text in capitals in the source.

styles.name: video-title
styles.usage: Title card on a 1920×1080 frame. Scale with the frame.

styles.name: video-heading
styles.usage: Scene headings on 1920×1080.

styles.name: video-body
styles.usage: On-screen bullet text on 1920×1080; at most three lines.

styles.name: video-caption
styles.sample: uv resolves the whole graph before it downloads
styles.usage: Subtitles on caption-plate, 1920×1080; two lines max.

styles.name: video-lower-third
styles.usage: Name line of a lower third; the role line uses video-label.

styles.name: video-label
styles.usage: Source credits, role lines, on-screen code labels.

spacing.note: A 4px base. UI uses space-1…space-20; video frames add the safe margins.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label in buttons; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding block; list row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button inline padding; card inner padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding in panels.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections (compact).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: video-safe
tokens.usage: Title-safe margin on a 1920×1080 frame (5%). Nothing but full-bleed media crosses it.

tokens.name: video-safe-vertical
tokens.usage: Title-safe margin on a 1080×1920 vertical short (10% of width); keep 320px clear at the bottom for platform UI.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, timecodes, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, code blocks, the player bar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Scene thumbnails, large panels, the caption plate in video.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero media and marketing panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Playhead knob and status dots only. No pill buttons.

shadow.note: Borders first. Shadows only for things that float above content.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the floating player bar.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: A video frame or screenshot shown as an object on a marketing page.

stroke.note: Line weights. The mark's frame is 5/64 of its size; UI icons follow at 1.5px.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: line and line-strong borders.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: UI icons (Lucide), round caps and joins.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring and selection outlines.

tokens.name: stroke-bracket
tokens.usage: Focus-frame corner brackets at UI size; scale to 5/64 of the framed box's short side in video.

duration.note: Motion is timed to narration; these are the UI defaults.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggles.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, tabs, small panels.

tokens.name: duration-frame
tokens.usage: Focus-frame brackets closing in on a target.

tokens.name: duration-scene
tokens.usage: Scene-to-scene transitions in the player and in video.

tokens.name: ease-cue
tokens.usage: Things arriving on a cue: brackets, captions, callouts. Fast out, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Layout moves and scene transitions.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving. Use about two-thirds of the entry duration.
